slides.text: Allow me to introduce myself. The person behind @scrollysocial

slides.bottom: Here's the short version of why Scrolly exists →

slides.text: Hi, I'm Mercedes. I help you turn content into customers.
I spent years in financial operations and reporting. Numbers are my comfort zone.
I kept coming up with business ideas, then getting stuck at the same spot: selling them.
So I learned marketing the way I learn everything: break it down, build a system, test it.
What I found: making content is easier than you think. Staying consistent is harder than you think.
Scrolly is for you if you want to make money online, or grow your business, without weeks of setup or paying for ads.
I love helping small businesses and solopreneurs carve out an income in a world built for big companies.
Off the clock: books, my cats, guitar and French lessons, and anything I can make with my hands. Coffee always hot.
Follow along for practical tips to help you reach your dreams. Go get 'em, tiger :)

caption: Follow along for practical tips to help you reach your dreams. I'm Mercedes, and I built Scrolly after years of having business ideas I didn't know how to sell. I'm an analyst at heart, so I learned marketing the only way I know how: break it into steps, build systems, and test what works. Now I share those systems so you don't have to build them from scratch. If you want the full plan for your first $1,000, the $1K Challenge is in my bio.
